# Blink

> Blink is an attention-first AI coach and calendar for people who
> struggle with focus and follow-through — it manages what needs you.
> Three tabs: Now shows the one thing to do; the Coach turns anything
> you type or dictate into tasks and scheduled time; the Inbox holds
> the decisions that need you, each a one-tap answer. iOS app, built by
> a solo founder who built it for himself first.

Blink is not a medical device, therapist, or substitute for professional
care.

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Distributed on the Apple App Store.
- What it does: a three-tab app — Now (the moment view: one thing to
  do, backed by day, month, and year calendar views), Coach
  (conversational capture: type or dictate to create tasks, repeating
  tasks, and scheduled blocks; AI task breakdown from vague task to
  concrete steps; memory is explicit opt-in), and Inbox (decisions that
  need you, answered in one tap). Plus adaptive reminders and a rewards
  system with progress that never resets to zero.
- What makes it different: follow-through. Most planning apps stop after
  the list exists; Blink keeps checking in on day 30 the same way it did
  on day 1.
- Cancellation: cancel anytime in one tap inside the app — no retention
  screens, no phone calls, no dark patterns. Subscriptions are billed and
  managed by Apple, so cancellation also works from iPhone Settings.
- Free tier: a genuinely usable free plan (daily-capped AI chat and task
  breakdown, up to 10 active tasks at a time, unlimited manual lists).
- Agent-ready: Blink speaks the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Any
  MCP-supporting AI (Claude via claude.ai custom connectors, Claude
  Code, Claude Desktop, others) can connect to the remote MCP server at
  https://api.coachblink.com/mcp with OAuth sign-in. Connected AIs get
  agent scope only: they can read tasks/calendar/reminders/capacity,
  propose tasks, and file decisions to the user's Inbox — they can never
  create, complete, delete, or schedule anything directly; every
  proposal waits for the user's one-tap accept or decline, enforced
  server-side.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://coachblink.com/pricing.md): Blink Pro is $9.99/month
  or $59.99/year (about $5.00/month, 50% off monthly). 7-day free trial.
  Free tier available forever.

## Learn more

- [Home](https://coachblink.com/): product overview and App Store link
- [Connect your AI (MCP)](https://coachblink.com/mcp.html): setup guide
  for connecting Claude or any MCP client to Blink — connector URL,
  Claude Code command, access scopes (agent/full/supervisor), the exact
  agent tool list, and what a connected AI can and cannot do
- [Blog](https://coachblink.com/blog/): essays on focus, follow-through,
  and why easy things feel impossible
- [Cancel anytime, actually](https://coachblink.com/blog/cancel-anytime-actually.html):
  our no-dark-patterns billing promise, in writing
